name: regelrecht-docs

scripts.check:source: npm run check:cited-paths && npm run check:prose && npm run check:rfc-coverage && npm run check:rfc-numbering && npm run check:schema-version
scripts.a11y: npm run build && node scripts/check-rfc-coverage.mjs && node scripts/check-roadmap-rfcs.mjs && node scripts/check-roadmap-belegging.mjs && node scripts/check-mermaid-alt.mjs && node scripts/check-heading-order.mjs && node scripts/check-links.mjs && node scripts/gen-pa11yci.mjs && ASTRO_PREVIEW_BACKGROUND=0 start-server-and-test 'astro preview --port 4173' http://localhost:4173 'pa11y-ci'

//ASTRO_PREVIEW_BACKGROUND: Set (to a falsy value) in the a11y script to keep `astro preview` in the FOREGROUND. Since astro 7 the preview command auto-detects an AI-agent environment (cli/agent.js isRunByAgent) and daemonises itself, printing a 'Stop: astro preview stop' banner and exiting immediately. start-server-and-test then sees the process exit, reports 'server closed unexpectedly', and pa11y-ci never runs, so the accessibility gate fails without a single a11y finding. The env var short-circuits that detection (it is only consulted for truthiness), while the value stays falsy so the lock file is still marked non-background. CI has no agent to detect and passes either way; this keeps the gate runnable from an agent session too.
//@astrojs/markdown-remark: Needed by astro.config.mjs (markdown.remarkPlugins/rehypePlugins): since astro 7.2 Sätteri is the default Markdown processor, so neither astro nor @astrojs/mdx installs this package itself — both only declare it as an optional peer (^7.3.0). Pinned exactly so the tree keeps one copy of it; bump it together with astro.
//overrides.pa11y-ci: pa11y-ci 4.1.1 pins pa11y ^9 and puppeteer ^24, whose @puppeteer/browsers still unpacks with extract-zip (GHSA-7pqw-9j4j-h8q3, GHSA-jmr9-qjv8-65gv, no fixed release). pa11y 10 is on puppeteer 25, which untars with modern-tar instead. Drop this override once pa11y-ci itself depends on pa11y 10.
